name: Cheikha Rimitti
contribution: Algerian female raï singer(8 May 1923- 15 May 2006).
legacy: She stopped smoking and drinking, but continued her singing and dancing, and by the mid-80s, when Rai was becoming established as the rousing dance music of angry young Algerians, this person was being hailed as la mamie du Rai, the grandmother of the style.

checks.lead: Cheikha Rimitti (Arabic: شيخة ريميتي; 8 May 1923 – 15 May 2006), born Saadia El Ghizania (سعدية الغيزانية), was an Algerian raï female singer.
